claims.claim: Hesychius of Jerusalem was a Christian priest and exegete, active during the first half of the fifth century.
Hesychius of Jerusalem served as a priest in the church in Jerusalem around 412.
Hesychius of Jerusalem was recognized by 429 as the pre-eminent biblical interpreter and teacher of the church in Jerusalem and Palestine.
The Homilia ii in sanctum pascha is one of two Homiliae in S. Pascha (CPG 6567-6568) by Hesychius of Jerusalem.
The Homilia ii in sanctum pascha survives in codex Sinaiticus gr. 492.
The Homilia ii in sanctum pascha was edited in an editio princeps by Michel Aubineau and published by Éditions du Cerf in 1972.
Hesychius of Jerusalem played a prominent role in the 5th-century controversy on the nature of Christ.
Hesychius of Jerusalem was renowned in the Eastern Church as a theologian, biblical commentator, and preacher.
Hesychius of Jerusalem was acclaimed as having annotated the whole of sacred Scripture.
Hesychius of Jerusalem was a prolific writer on Biblical, particularly Old Testament, exegetics.
Hesychius of Jerusalem was a monk in early life before becoming presbyter at Jerusalem.
